data.name: Sunya
data.long_meaning: The name Sunya in Arabic means 'empty', 'void', or 'absence'. It can also be interpreted as the concept of nothingness or the essence of existence itself. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Allah (God) created the universe from nothingness (sunya) and sustains it. Thus, the name Sunya carries deep spiritual significance and can be given to babies as a reminder of their connection to the divine.
